cases.scenario: A reviewer brief names `mo-reviewer` under Reviewer-Skill, carries a full SHA, `Spec: docs/specifications/feature.md`, deep mode, an isolated checkout at that SHA and `Body-File: <dir>/slot-a-r1-d1.md`; Orca's preamble names the Dispatch `ctx_fixture`. The change has one proven P2 defect: a requirement of the specification is not implemented.
must: under §A-ACTIVATION-01 act as one terminal reviewer without starting the coordinator review skill or any other worker

under §A-REVIEW-04 start the body with the bare `Review-Execution: ctx_fixture` line, prove HEAD and a clean tree in Grounding and report the missing requirement as F-001 [P2] with causal path, impact, invariant, direction and regression case
under §A-REVIEW-04 create the Body-File through `mo-review-report.mjs prepare`, obtain status=valid and send exactly that file's bytes
mustNot: run the project's tests, linter or QC gate
put the validator line MO-REVIEW-REPORT/1 or an explanation into the service lines
send a summary instead of the complete report

cases.scenario: A user asks for a generic code review of their branch in a session where `mo-reviewer` is installed but not named, and no reviewer brief exists.
must: under §A-ACTIVATION-01 leave the skill inactive and answer the generic request outside the Meta-O lifecycle
mustNot: invent a Review-Execution id or a Dispatch
create a Body-File or start Orca workers

cases.scenario: The brief names `mo-reviewer` and a candidate SHA, but the reviewer's checkout stands on another commit, and the prepared Body-File path already exists with somebody else's bytes. In a second Dispatch on the right commit the brief carries no `Knowledge-Layer:` line and the change postpones work.
must: under §A-REVIEW-04 answer UNKNOWN with Unknown-Reason candidate_mismatch and a non-empty Unknown-Account instead of reviewing the checked-out commit
under §A-REVIEW-04 treat `status=refused reason=exists` from prepare as a question to the caller and leave the existing file untouched
under §A-MEMORY-05 answer the deferral lens of the second Dispatch as unknown because the brief lacks the Knowledge-Layer line
mustNot: overwrite or delete the existing Body-File
move HEAD, stash or reset the checkout to reach the candidate
assume an ordinary project with knowledge gates when the Knowledge-Layer line is missing
